about.description:
OpenMVS reconstructs dense point clouds, meshes and textured meshes from
calibrated photos (e.g. a COLMAP, Metashape or OpenMVG camera solution).
`openmvs` ships the command-line tools, the viewer (OpenMVSViewer) and the shared
libraries (with CUDA variants on Linux); `pyopenmvs` ships the Python
bindings (pyOpenMVS).

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.4.0"
  build: 0
  cuda: ${{ cuda_compiler_version != "None" }}
  cuda_major: ${{ (cuda_compiler_version | default("None") | split(".") | list)[0] }}
  # Prefer the most optimised x86_64 microarchitecture, then CUDA builds.
  build_number: ${{ build + 100 * (microarch_level | default(1) | int - 1) + (50 if cuda else 0) }}

recipe:
  name: openmvs-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cdcseacave/openMVS/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1668a991fa1fdd3540ee47fdba282a7579ed876af713e8fa907625be1cf8dfc8
  patches:
    # Boost >= 1.89 no longer ships a boost_system library / CMake config
    # (backport: fixed upstream in e884035, #1286)
    - patches/0001-Do-not-require-the-boost_system-library-header-only-.patch
    # OpenCV 5: DataType<unsigned/uint64_t> now built in, DIST_* moved to geometry
    # (submitted upstream: cdcseacave/openMVS#1317)
    - patches/0002-Support-OpenCV-5.patch
    # imgui >= 1.92 removed ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowItemOverlap
    # (backport: fixed upstream in 6871967)
    - patches/0003-Viewer-use-ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowOverlap-old-nam.patch
    # upstream's pkg-config helper only resolves static libjxl
    # (backport: fixed upstream in e2f38b4, #1289/#1294)
    - patches/0004-Link-libjxl-through-its-pkg-config-imported-target.patch
    # one Log instance across the shared libraries (was inline per library)
    # (backport: fixed upstream in 4694ded, #1279)
    - patches/0005-Define-the-Log-singletons-in-Log.cpp.patch
    # macOS: keep the toolchain's linker flags (tools linked the system libc++)
    # (submitted upstream: cdcseacave/openMVS#1318)
    - patches/0006-Append-stdlib-libc-to-CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS-instead.patch
    # CUDA builds without a GPU/driver: do not log uninitialized error strings
    # (backport: first commit of upstream #1316, open)
    - patches/0007-Do-not-log-uninitialized-CUDA-error-strings.patch
    # install into bin/ and lib/ instead of bin/OpenMVS and lib/OpenMVS
    # (backport: fixed upstream in e884035, #1286/#1272)
    - patches/0008-Add-INSTALL_USE_SUBDIR-to-install-without-per-projec.patch
    # library file names prefixed with OpenMVS (libOpenMVSMVS, ...), so the
    # generic names (Common, IO, Math) cannot clash in lib/ (opt-in, not upstream yet)
    - patches/0009-Add-OpenMVS_LIBRARY_NAME_PREFIX-to-prefix-the-librar.patch
    # make the installed CMake package usable: find_dependency() for the
    # exported targets' dependencies, relocatable paths, include directory
    # (not fixed upstream yet)
    - patches/0010-Make-the-installed-CMake-package-usable.patch
    # build without the IBFS max-flow solver (research-only license); the build
    # scripts delete libs/Math/IBFS and ReconstructMesh uses Boost's solver
    - patches/0011-Add-OpenMVS_USE_IBFS-to-build-without-the-IBFS-max-f.patch
    # use conda-forge's tinyxml2, nlohmann_json and tinygltf instead of the
    # copies in libs/IO (deleted by the build scripts)
    - patches/0012-Use-system-tinyxml2-nlohmann-json-and-tinygltf.patch
    # name the Viewer's icon and .reg file after VIEWER_NAME (the recipe uses
    # OpenMVSViewer: generic Viewer names clash, e.g. embree's bin/viewer); fix
    # the desktop entry's Exec path (not upstream yet)
    - patches/0013-Viewer-name-the-installed-icon-and-.reg-after-VIEWER.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: openmvs
    build:
      number: ${{ build_number }}
      string: ${{ ("cuda" ~ cuda_major) if cuda else "cpu" }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script:
        - if: win
          then: call %RECIPE_DIR%\build_openmvs.bat
          else: bash $RECIPE_DIR/build_openmvs.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: unix and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: cuda
          then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        # Eigen types are part of OpenMVS's public headers: eigen-abi-devel, at the
        # same microarch level as the build (EIGEN_MAX_ALIGN_BYTES)
        - if: unix and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - if: osx
          then: llvm-openmp
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
        - if: cuda
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-driver-dev
            - libcurand-dev
        - libboost-devel
        - eigen
        - libopencv
        - tinyxml2
        - nlohmann_json
        - tinygltf
        - cgal-cpp
        - nanoflann
        - vcglib
        - gmp
        - mpfr
        - libpng
        - libjpeg-turbo
        - libtiff
        - libjxl
        - zlib
        # Viewer
        - glad
        - glfw
        - imgui
        # imgui's CMake config also requires SDL2 and Vulkan
        - sdl2
        - libvulkan-headers
        - libvulkan-loader
        - portable-file-dialogs
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libgl-devel
            - libegl-devel
      run:
        - if: cuda
          then: __cuda
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('openmvs', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libvulkan-headers
          - sdl2
          - libvulkan-loader
    tests:
      - script:
          # The tools print their usage and exit with status 1 on --help.
          # CUDA builds link the CUDA driver (libcuda.so.1); without one (as on CI)
          # they cannot start, so only run them when a driver is present.
          - if: unix and not cuda
            then: for t in DensifyPointCloud InterfaceCOLMAP ReconstructMesh RefineMesh TextureMesh; do $t --help > help.txt || test $? -eq 1; grep -q "Available options" help.txt; done
          - if: unix and cuda
            then: if ( /sbin/ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null || true ) | grep -q "libcuda.so.1"; then for t in DensifyPointCloud InterfaceCOLMAP ReconstructMesh RefineMesh TextureMesh; do $t --help > help.txt || test $? -eq 1; grep -q "Available options" help.txt; done; else echo "no CUDA driver, not running the tools"; fi
          # Windows: the console log may open its own console instead of writing to
          # the redirected stdout, so also look in the log file each tool writes
          - if: win
            then: for %%t in (DensifyPointCloud InterfaceCOLMAP ReconstructMesh RefineMesh TextureMesh) do (call %%t --help > help.txt 2>&1 & type help.txt & findstr /M /C:"Available options" help.txt %%t-*.log || exit 1)
      - package_contents:
          files:
            exists:
              - if: unix
                then:
                  - include/OpenMVS/MVS/Scene.h
                  - include/OpenMVS/ConfigLocal.h
                  - lib/cmake/OpenMVS/OpenMVSConfig.cmake
                  - lib/cmake/OpenMVS/OpenMVSTargets.cmake
              - if: linux
                then: lib/libOpenMVSMVS.so
              - if: osx
                then: lib/libOpenMVSMVS.dylib
              - if: unix
                then:
                  - bin/DensifyPointCloud
                  - bin/InterfaceCOLMAP
                  - bin/TextureMesh
                  - bin/OpenMVSViewer
              # Windows: OpenMVS 2.4.0's libraries are linked statically into
              # the tools (shared Windows builds came after 2.4.0)
              - if: win
                then:
                  - Library/bin/DensifyPointCloud.exe
                  - Library/bin/InterfaceCOLMAP.exe
                  - Library/bin/OpenMVSViewer.exe
            not_exists:
              - lib/OpenMVS/**
              - bin/OpenMVS/**
              # no generic Viewer names (VIEWER_NAME=OpenMVSViewer)
              - bin/Viewer
              - share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/Viewer.svg
              - share/doc/Viewer/**
              - if: unix
                then: lib/libOpenMVS*.a
                else:
                  - Library/lib/OpenMVS*.lib
                  - Library/include/OpenMVS/**

  - package:
      name: pyopenmvs
    build:
      number: ${{ build_number }}
      string: py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}${{ ("cuda" ~ cuda_major) if cuda else "cpu" }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script:
        - if: win
          then: call %RECIPE_DIR%\build_pyopenmvs.bat
          else: bash $RECIPE_DIR/build_pyopenmvs.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        # same microarch level as the openmvs build it links (Eigen alignment)
        - if: unix and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: cuda
          then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        # the same openmvs build: CUDA changes the layout of OpenMVS classes
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('openmvs', exact=True) }}
        # OpenMVS's public headers use Eigen
        - if: unix and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - python
        - if: osx
          then: llvm-openmp
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
        - if: cuda
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-driver-dev
            - libcurand-dev
        - libboost-devel
        - libboost-python-devel
        - eigen
        - libopencv
        - cgal-cpp
        - nanoflann
        - vcglib
        - gmp
        - mpfr
        # find_package(OpenMVS) finds the image libraries OpenMVS::IO links (and
        # Windows builds OpenMVS's static libraries into the module itself)
        - libjxl
        - libpng
        - libjpeg-turbo
        - libtiff
        - zlib
        # Windows builds OpenMVS in-tree (see build_pyopenmvs.bat)
        - if: win
          then:
            - tinyxml2
            - nlohmann_json
            - tinygltf
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('openmvs', exact=True) }}
        - python
    tests:
      - script:
          # CUDA builds need the CUDA driver to load (see the openmvs tests)
          - if: cuda
            then: if ( /sbin/ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null || true ) | grep -q "libcuda.so.1"; then python -c "import pyOpenMVS; print(pyOpenMVS.Scene())"; else echo "no CUDA driver, not importing pyOpenMVS"; fi
            else: python -c "import pyOpenMVS; print(pyOpenMVS.Scene())"
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - if: win
              then: Lib/site-packages/pyOpenMVS.pyd
              else: lib/python*/site-packages/pyOpenMVS.so
